entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Elite cabal of mages on Esper seeking carmot to create new etherium.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara where the Seekers were based.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who manipulated the Seekers.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Artificer from Tidehollow, scorned by the Seekers, who later destroyed them.

entities.name: Amalex Pannet
entities.description: Seeker Hieresiarch dismissed Tezzeret and was killed by him.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: Younger artificer who found sangrite could replace carmot.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Bolas's covert organization, taken over by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: Mythical substance believed essential for creating etherium.

events.summary: Tezzeret killed Hieresiarch Amalex Pannet after being dismissed from the Academy.
Seekers guards attacked Tezzeret in the Vault and triggered his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: they triggered his planeswalker spark , and Tezzeret disappeared

events.summary: Tezzeret was inducted into Bolas's Infinite Consortium and took it over.
events.quote: Tezzeret staged a takeover of the organization

events.summary: Tezzeret returned and murdered the entire sect, then made the Academy his fortress.
Breya discovered sangrite could replace carmot in forging etherium.
events.quote: could be used in place of carmot to forge new etherium

relations.quote: The Elder Dragon manipulated them into an obsession
being inducted into the Elder Dragon 's covert organization
